value.rationale: The sharp dichotomy separates whole-vector independence across two part classes from strict conditional negative dependence of arbitrary disjoint all-leaf events for any three-or-more-part model. It supplies exact all-order structural dependence information and the joint leaf law, beyond a lone marginal or isolated low-order covariance; no false claim of full negative association is made.
